plugins.name: session-memory
plugins.description: Cross-session memory for ZCode: auto-loads global and project memory at session start; ships /remember, /memory commands and a memory-management skill.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 跨会话记忆：会话开始自动加载全局与项目记忆；含 /remember 快存、/memory 查看命令与记忆管理技能（Windows/macOS/Linux）

plugins.name: steam-workshop
plugins.description: Steam Workshop access for ZCode via MCP: search and inspect items for any game; download via steamcmd; analyze RimWorld mod code (About.xml dependencies, loadFolders, MayRequire, PatchOperations, Harmony patches) for compatibility/integration development.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 搜索/查阅任意游戏创意工坊 + 下载 mod 并做 RimWorld 深度代码分析（依赖、MayRequire 联动点、Harmony 补丁目标），多平台

plugins.name: desktop-bridge
plugins.description: Desktop bridge for ZCode via MCP: read/write the clipboard, show notifications, open files/folders/URLs with executable guardrails, and query system info. Windows (PowerShell/WinRT), macOS (pbcopy/osascript/open) and Linux (xclip/wl-clipboard/notify-send/xdg-open).

description_i18n.zh-CN: 让 ZCode 触达桌面：剪贴板读写、系统通知、安全打开文件/文件夹/网页、系统信息（Windows/macOS/Linux）

plugins.name: img2prompt
plugins.description: Image-to-prompt for ZCode: extract embedded generation parameters from AI images (SD/A1111, ComfyUI, NovelAI PNG metadata; JPEG EXIF) and a structured skill that turns any image into refined image-generation prompts (SD tags, natural language, Midjourney, negative prompts, img2img parameter suggestions).

description_i18n.zh-CN: 图片转生图提示词：优先提取 AI 图片内嵌原始参数（SD/ComfyUI/NovelAI、JPEG EXIF）直接复刻，配合八维视觉分析与四种提示词输出格式（SD tag/自然语言/Midjourney/负面提示词）
